title: Buyers want named references from their own sector
summary: Utility and waste buyers look for a reference in their own sector before booking a call. Larkwell's two named clients should be on the home page.

title: Patch-day posts get read by Basis leads
summary: Short, practical posts on the day of the SAP security notes reach Basis leads. Larkwell should post one each month, written the day before.

title: Service pages have no FAQ structured data
summary: The plant maintenance and billing service pages answer common questions in prose but carry no FAQ markup. Adding it is a small change.

title: No competitor writes for waste operators
summary: Of the five firms on file, none has content for waste collection or recycling operators. Brackenfield Waste gives Larkwell a credible angle.

title: Utility buyers search for billing exceptions by symptom
summary: Searches name the symptom (implausible reads, move-in dates), not the module. Larkwell's billing content should lead with the symptom and name the SAP fix second.

title: Few pages answer 'SAP PM mobile work orders' with SAP detail
summary: The top results are vendor product pages for generic mobile apps. None explains how work orders, notifications and readings flow back into SAP PM. Larkwell should own this with a practical guide.
